notes: The site was found at the published coordinates: the fenced protected area east of the highway, with the water-filled dock basin on its east side. Zoom 19 tiles are placeholders here. All points are read on the 2023-08 Wayback release at z18, where the dock's water is low and its walls are exposed; in the current 2026 image the water overtops the oblique north wall, and the same corners read on it agree with the 2023 values to 1-2 px. The drawing is a redrawing of Rao 1979 at a small scale; dock and warehouse are drawn as outlines a few pixels wide, and the points are taken at the centres of the drawn lines and at the inner water edge of the dock. Exploratory fits on scratch files outside the control directory were used to check the Acropolis and Lower Town candidates before they were rejected. The drawing carries a north arrow, which was not used.
